verdicts.reason: A drops the sea photo entirely, so it loses a key part of the brand look. Its layout is scattered: the headline is jammed against the left edge, the logo floats centred above it on no shared edge, and the subcopy sits off in the top right with a bad 'Book / by Sunday.' break. B keeps the photo panel (though cropped tighter, to hills and water) and holds the logo, headline and subcopy together in one group, but the Book Now button almost touches '$89' and the logo isn't aligned with the headline's left edge.
